title: Mini App Canvas
summary: Mini App Canvas brings interactive apps and dashboards into Vibe Work. From a single prompt, create an app you can review, edit, and share without writing code or leaving the conversation.
whatsNew: Turn your ideas and data into interactive dashboards, reports, and tools, rather than working only with static text. Build from a prompt or use data gathered through Connectors and Workflows, then refine the result in Canvas without starting over.
keyCapabilities: Multi-file React generation: Vibe Work creates components, data, and styles that work together as one interactive app.
In-place editing: Refine the app through the conversation and see the changes in the same Canvas, without writing code.
Data-backed apps: Generate dashboards, reports, and tools from data gathered through Connectors or Workflows, instead of starting from scratch.
Flexible sharing: Share the Canvas alone or the whole conversation. Re-share after editing to update the shared link; changes are not synchronized continuously.
Snapshot limits: Mini apps capture data at generation time, without live refresh or saved actions inside the app. Retrieve fresh data and regenerate the app to update it.

getStarted.label: Describe the dashboard, report, or tool you want to create in Vibe Work. Follow the mini apps guide to refine and share it.
